objective: Determine whether two measured V88 defects can be corrected while preserving fail-closed English/domain segregation on source-record-disjoint actual teacher outputs.

development_evidence.use: development/error-analysis only; never counted as V89 holdout evidence

bounded_changes: Recognize Python imports only as line-anchored Python syntax; ordinary English 'from' phrases are not Python signals.
Treat the ontology capability name python_generation in the semantic domain field as a schema-displaced corroboration of the deterministic Python signal.
Make no other label-rule, ontology, threshold, source, or classifier change.

all_required: overall exact destination-plus-domain accuracy at least 0.95
zero non-English records mislabeled as English core
known-domain macro exact-domain F1 at least 0.95
quarantine recall at least 0.95 and each quarantine-family recall at least 0.90
100% parsed outputs, EOS termination, and authoritative token accounting
exact source, ontology, implementation, and source-record exclusion identities
LayerCake never invoked and no training artifact composed

decision_rule: PASS certifies bounded pre-transfer labeling for this locked ontology and evidence population. FAIL blocks data sufficiency and normalization. No V89 repair or validation-label tuning is permitted.
claim_boundary: V89 cannot prove exhaustive domain discovery, arbitrary-record classification, pure English weights, normalized transfer data, sufficient training volume, minimality, or downstream LayerCake quality.
